At \(x\asymp\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}\), this remainder is negligible relative to \(\varepsilon x^{-3}/\log(1/\varepsilon)\). The exact Gaussian solution, implicit \(y-\tfrac32\log y\) matching equation, and phase yield an \(O(1/L)\) complex ratio. Continuous phase winding establishes both intensity envelope bounds, not merely numerical observations.
